en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a lively open-air market in a European square. Dozens of stalls with canvas awnings fill the plaza, crowded with vendors and shoppers in early-20th‑century clothing. In the foreground stands a large stone pedestal bearing a bronze statue of a robed man holding a book and gesturing toward the square. Surrounding the market are grand neoclassical and Renaissance-style buildings with arched ground floors and ornate windows.
